name: P-015 R-3 live-plane observation on the STAGING operator (2026-09-24c): ideate on/off stack transition served by :3170 4be87080b9, desired->prepared->applied receipts, coord:orient leaves a pending activation for turn-start (WI-10002717), actor/principal stability, per-layer span join
command: bash .papercusp/scratch/r7/r3-drill6.sh   # per transition: mode:set -> coord:orient {afterCompaction} -> DB snapshot -> turn-start boundary (POST http://127.0.0.1:3170/api/agent-mcp/turn-start-memory, UserPromptSubmit hook body shape) -> DB snapshot -> reads; tool calls via node scripts/mcp-call.mjs --port 3170; ONE shell so no :3070 hook acknowledged a generation; the script captures its own id floors and generates q-all.sql
sudo -n -u postgres psql -d papercusp -X < .papercusp/scratch/r7/r3-drill6/q-all.sql   # read-only; SQL in replication[]
commandBasis: Copied from the drill script and the read-only query file it generated beside its outputs (timeline .papercusp/scratch/r7/r3-drill6/timeline.txt, results q-all.txt). The script's own psql -f call failed with "Permission denied" (the postgres role cannot read a file under the observer's home), so the unedited q-all.sql was re-run read-only on stdin. The generated window 2026-09-24T15:22:47Z - 2026-09-24T15:23:15Z was used as written: v5 rounds the window end up, so no bound was corrected.
timeBasis: startedAt is the :3170 /api/health read that opened the drill (sha 4be87080b9); finishedAt is the drill's own done stamp. The drill window used by q-all.sql is 2026-09-24T15:22:47Z - 2026-09-24T15:23:15Z. Snapshots use database clock_timestamp() between steps.
summary: Doc 2026-09-24a (build 41b4c7a88e) predates control-anchor.ts commit 33f6d2eb12 (2026-09-24 12:20Z), which made buildControlAnchorState pass the selected mode catalog (agent-identities/source getSelectedModeCatalog) into stackRefsForSession, so the stack refs this drill observes are now derived through that catalog. identity-grants-port.ts is unchanged (150edc7d8d). This drill ran the same ideate on/off transition through :3170 at 4be87080b9, whose four R-3 source blobs equal canonical HEAD and the working tree. Each transition first called coord:orient {afterCompaction}; both times orient returned ok and the activation stayed pending (status desired, delivered watermark not advanced). The turn-start boundary then wrote prepared and applied. Enabling ideate produced generation 151 (desired 19519, prepared 19520, applied 19521) and disabling it produced generation 152 (19522 / 19523 / 19524). Every event carries actor == owner, principal system:superuser and adv session 29827. The gen-151 activation opened 2 layer spans, including ideation:su.mode-ideate, closed exactly when gen 152 applied; gen 152 opened 1 without ideation. All seven drill tool calls were served by port-3170 at 4be87080b9.

subject.note: The observer's own psu session. The transient ideate overlay was enabled and disabled within 28 seconds purely as a stack transition to observe; the session's AUTO mode was unchanged throughout.

sourceBlobs.basis: git rev-parse <ref>:<path>; identical in 4be87080b9 (the papercusp-staging checkout :3170 serves), canonical HEAD 4be87080b9 and the working tree

replication.sql: \pset footer off \echo === q-activation (events > baseline 19518, drill window 2026-09-24T15:22:47Z - 2026-09-24T15:23:15Z) SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, e.id, e.control_generation AS gen, e.phase, e.source, e.stack_refs, left(e.specification_revision,12) AS spec, left(e.state_revision,12) AS state, e.adv_session_id AS adv, e.actor_id = e.owner_id AS actor_is_owner, e.principal_id, e.failure, e.recorded_at FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events e WHERE e.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND e.owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND e.id > 19518 AND e.recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-24T15:22:47Z' AND '2026-09-24T15:23:15Z' ORDER BY e.id; SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at, control_generation, control_delivered_generation, control_state->'activation'->>'status' AS status FROM harness_shared.session_briefs WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace'; \echo === q-spans (spans opened by the drill applied events) SELECT count(*) AS span_count_now FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd'; SELECT activation_event_id, control_generation, actor_id, principal_id, layer_slot, layer_ref, active_from, active_until FROM harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND activation_event_id IN (SELECT id FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND id > 19518 AND phase='applied' AND recorded_at BETWEEN '2026-09-24T15:22:47Z' AND '2026-09-24T15:23:15Z') ORDER BY activation_event_id, layer_slot; \echo === q-serving (tool calls served inside the drill window) SELECT id, tool_name, status, serving_host, serving_build_sha, invoked_at FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE id > 29425708 AND coord_owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND invoked_at BETWEEN '2026-09-24T15:22:47Z' AND '2026-09-24T15:23:15Z' ORDER BY id; \echo === q-usage (usage samples attributed to the drill activations) SELECT id, to_timestamp(ts/1000.0) AS at, source, model_class, session_id, identity_activation_event_id, identity_owner_id FROM harness_shared.agent_usage_samples_identity_attribution WHERE ts BETWEEN (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-24T15:22:47Z')*1000)::bigint AND (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-24T15:23:15Z')*1000)::bigint AND (identity_owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' OR session_id ILIKE '%38e71009%' OR identity_activation_event_id IN (SELECT id FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events WHERE owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND id > 19518 AND phase='applied')) ORDER BY id;

replication.note: re-running it performs a new transient ideate on/off transition for the invoking owner; it captures fresh id floors and regenerates q-all.sql for its own window

assertions.evidence: Served by :3170 4be87080b9. mode:set ideate=on (15:22:47.158Z-15:22:49.019Z) wrote 19519 desired gen 151 (spec 663b4258c93d, state 8696e0f4fa9b, stack autonomy:su.mode-auto + ideation:su.mode-ideate). The turn-start boundary (15:22:56.827Z-15:22:59.854Z) then wrote 19520 prepared and 19521 applied with the same revision pair. mode:set ideate=off wrote 19522 desired gen 152 (spec 663b4258c93d, state 6d031da47dd3, stack autonomy:su.mode-auto); its turn-start (15:23:09.017Z-15:23:11.909Z) wrote 19523 prepared and 19524 applied. session_briefs after each turn-start: 151/151 applied, then 152/152 applied.

WI-10002717 live check on the new build. Before each turn-start the drill called coord:orient {afterCompaction:true} through :3170 (15:22:49.112Z-15:22:56.729Z and 15:23:03.723Z-15:23:08.932Z). Both returned ok:true. The snapshots straight after them read generation/delivered/status 151/150/desired (2026-09-24 11:22:56.820429-04) and 152/151/desired (2026-09-24 11:23:09.011177-04): the delivery watermark was NOT advanced and the activation stayed pending until the turn-start boundary.

All six events carry actor_id == owner_id, principal_id system:superuser and adv_session_id 29827, with no failure. The 3 spans opened by 19521/19524 carry the same actor and principal. The transition did not re-attribute the session.

session_identity_layer_spans for the owner: activation 19521 (gen 151) opened 2 spans (autonomy:su.mode-auto, ideation:su.mode-ideate), active 2026-09-24 11:22:57.14621-04 - 2026-09-24 11:23:09.089596-04. Activation 19524 (gen 152) opened 1 (autonomy:su.mode-auto) from 2026-09-24 11:23:09.089596-04, still open at read time, with no ideation span. The ideation layer is attributable to exactly the 12-second window its activation was applied. Usage join (usage-attribution.txt, read 2026-09-24T15:27:03.913Z): no sample has joined onto a drill activation yet.

tool_invocations for the owner in 2026-09-24T15:22:47Z - 2026-09-24T15:23:15Z: all seven drill calls (mode:set x2, coord:orient x2, state:read x2, work_items:get) carry serving_host port-3170 and serving_build_sha 4be87080b9, as do the reads coord:orient fans out to (coord:inbox, coord:plan-events, coord:whoami, fleet:assignments, plans:get, work_items:list, work_items:observe). The 0 non-3170 rows in the window are the observer session's own concurrent calls (); none is a mode or activation write.

The :3170 turn-start-memory responses carried both payloads. 12 (after ideate on): ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ reason next-generation, generations 150->151, with ⟦stack⟧ attach ops for ideation. It is a delta, not a full resync, because the delivered watermark equalled the generation at drill start (snapshot 00-baseline 150/150/applied), so the pending transition's previousGeneration 150 matched it; decideControlTransitionDelivery (control-anchor.ts) delivers the delta in that case. 17 (after ideate off): ⟦CTRL:transition⟧ reason next-generation, 151->152, with a ⟦stack⟧ detach op for slot ideation.
